what_broke: Carta company_embeddings.json was empty — BFS crawl returned nothing
root_cause: BFS queue never seeded with base_url when no seed_urls provided + carta.com behind Cloudflare JS challenge.
fix_applied: Always append base_url to priority_queue. Added 3-tier fallback: httpx → Playwright headless Chromium → Wayback Machine.
lesson: Always seed BFS with base_url. Major sites use Cloudflare — need headless browser fallback.

what_broke: Trafilatura flattens structural HTML elements — ordered_list_count, table_count all zero
root_cause:
trafilatura.extract() converts
    ,
    , into

    tags. Counting on trafilatura output yields 0.
fix_applied: Dual-soup architecture: trafilatura for text extraction, semantic-tag-only scoping for element counting.
lesson: trafilatura is for text, NOT structural HTML analysis. Always use original HTML for counting.

what_broke: textstat.flesch_kincaid_grade() failed — NLTK cmudict not found
root_cause: textstat depends on NLTK cmudict corpus, not downloaded. SSL cert issue blocked auto-download.
fix_applied: Manual download + try/except guard with default 0.0 on failure.
lesson: textstat depends on NLTK corpora. Ensure cmudict is available in deployment.

what_broke: Persona/style guide agents produce .draft.md files never promoted to .md
root_cause: LangGraph >=1.0 changed interrupt model — invoke returns __interrupt__ in dict instead of raising GraphInterrupt. CLI scripts caught dead exception.
fix_applied: Created shared _cli_approval.py helper. Replaced GraphInterrupt catch with __interrupt__ dict check.
lesson: LangGraph >=1.0: interrupt() returns __interrupt__ in result dict, not GraphInterrupt exception.

what_broke: math domain error in _pearson() — math.sqrt received negative value
root_cause: Floating-point cancellation makes the product slightly negative (~-1e-15).
fix_applied: Guard: if product <= 0: return 0.0 before math.sqrt().
lesson: Any math.sqrt() on computed product needs negative-value guard for floating-point imprecision.

what_broke: 25 registration tests failed after adding password min_length=8
root_cause: Existing tests used short passwords like 'p1', 'pass'. Pydantic validation rejected with 422.
fix_applied: Updated API-level test passwords to meet 8-char minimum. Store-level tests keep short passwords (different layer).
lesson: When adding validation constraints to request models, check all test fixtures using those models.

what_broke: Type annotation assertion failure — annotation was string, not class
root_cause: `from __future__ import annotations` makes annotations strings at runtime. inspect.signature().return_annotation returns string.
lesson: Never use inspect.signature().return_annotation with `from __future__ import annotations`. Use get_type_hints().

what_broke: DB tests showed ERROR instead of SKIP without TEST_DATABASE_URL
root_cause: conftest.py pytestmark doesn't propagate to all test files in the directory.
fix_applied: Added pytestmark auto-skip directly to each DB test file.
lesson: Every tests/db/ file must include its own pytestmark auto-skip.

what_broke: RuntimeError: no running event loop in DbTaskStore sync tests
root_cause: asyncio.create_task() in sync methods requires a running event loop. Patching instance method doesn't intercept before create_task.
fix_applied: Patch asyncio.create_task at module level, make tests async.
lesson: Patch asyncio.create_task at module level, not instance method. Tests must be async for event loop context.

what_broke: tests/api/test_site_audit.py hung indefinitely — zero output, process never completed
root_cause: mock_site_audit_pipeline fixture patched api.tasks.runner.run_site_audit_task (source module) but router does 'from api.tasks.runner import run_site_audit_task' creating a local binding. Mock never reached the router — real pipeline launched via asyncio.create_task() and tried to crawl live websites.
lesson: When a module uses 'from X import Y', patching 'X.Y' does NOT affect the importer's local binding. Always patch at the point of use: patch the importing module's attribute, not the source module's.
